Since Chinese equity incentive regulation uses the stock price before ESO’ report date as the pricing benchmark for the exercise price, we detect managerial opportunism by observing the stock returns surrounding the dates of ESO incentive plan report. Using the data of Chinese listed companies that reported ESO incentive plan from 2009 to 2015, this paper find that the cumulative abnormal returns is significantly negative before the ESO plan reported and significantly positive afterward, indicating that stock price decrease prior to the report dates of ESO plan and increase afterward. The V-shaped pattern of stock price movement around ESO report dates indicates that there are obvious opportunistic behaviors in the exercise price determination process of executive stock options. Regulators should make a longer time window as the pricing benchmark for ESO’ exercise price so as to prevent top managers from manipulating exercise price of their options.

articleTitle: An Image Comparison Algorithm Based on Contour Similarity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: In the evaluation of camouflage effect, the contour similarity of an object before and after it is camouflaged can be used to determine. Because the background of the object in the image may affect the recognition of contour feature for the object, this paper proposes an image contour recognition algorithm based on binary convolution moment. Firstly, binary processing an image. Secondly the image is segmented evenly, followed that the local segmented images are extracted by the feature binaries, then a convolution matrix is constructed. Finally, the method of Euclidean distance and cosine distance normalization is used to calculate the contour-feature similarity of the object. Thus the contour similarity value of the object in the image is obtained. In order to verify the effectiveness of this algorithm, this work have done a comparative experiment between the image data set with similar object contour and the image data set with different object contour, as well as comparing the experimental results with Hu moment algorithm. The results show that, this algorithm can effectively identify the contour of two images before and after camouflage, and calculate the contour similarity of the two images as the evaluation index of camouflage effect.

articleTitle: Establishment and Application of Big Data Processing Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, more and more enterprises begin to use big data technology to deal with related analysis work. Hadoop is the dominant processing platform in the field of big data, an ecosystem that integrates distributed computing, storage, and management. The Spark framework, on the other hand, is a faster, more versatile distributed computing platform. However, it is only a computing platform and does not provide distributed storage and management per se, and computing remains dependent on distributed file system HDFS and cluster Resource Manager Yarn in the Hadoop ecosystem. Therefore, the combination of Spark and Hadoop to build a big data processing platform can better improve the algorithm efficiency and processing scale. This article explains the setup process and running state of Hadoop and Spark in detail, and verifies its feasibility through several ways.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Health Status of Complex Equipment Based on Degradation Degree
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the assessment of the health status of complex equipment affected by multiple factors, the concept of deterioration degree is introduced, combined with the characteristics of the complex equipment itself, and on the basis of determining the evaluation index system, the deterioration degree is used as a unified measurement index, and the variable weight fuzzy comprehensive evaluation theory is used With the analytic hierarchy process, an evaluation method based on the variable weight fuzzy comprehensive evaluation theory of deterioration degree to evaluate the health of self-propelled artillery is proposed. Finally, combined with the actual working characteristics of complex equipment, the whole-gun subsystem of a certain type of self-propelled gun is taken as an example to verify the rationality and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Business Process Transformation and FSS Evaluation Under Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Financial Sharing Service(FSS) based on cloud computing is a new financial management mode introduced to China in recent ten years, whose core is to realize the flow process and standardization of a company's business through process re-engineering. Many Chinese domestic enterprises begin to build financial sharing service center, aiming to promote business process re-engineering based on the promotion of business efficiency and thus value increment. Following the introduction of the concept of cloud computing and shared services, this paper explores a new business process mode after the combination of these two and evaluates the overall implementation effect of Financial Shared Services in the sample enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Curve Drawing Method Based on VB.NET
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Usually when designing a monitoring system, it is often necessary to use real-time fluctuation curves to represent the real-time situation of the current monitoring area. In order to achieve the representation of dynamic curves in various monitoring systems, this article uses VB.Net language on the VS2008 platform and uses GDI+ The class library realizes the drawing of the curve and the display of the coordinate axis. It conducts key research on the drawing and refreshing of the dynamic curve, solves the problem of the coordinate axis flickering, etc., and verifies this method of drawing the dynamic curve in conjunction with the example program. Experimental results show that the dynamic real-time curve class designed by this method has good real-time performance, strong versatility, and can be widely used.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Virtual Experiment Network Platform for Rig Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the continuous development of oil and gas exploration technology, virtual reality technology has been introduced into rig control teaching and research field. Using the network technology, the interactive platform provides a new way which can reduce training cost, the risk of authentic drilling research as well as the limitation of space and time. It is introduced how to design virtual experiment network platform based on Web technology which is included control practical operations, control optimization and online examination projects for rig control. It integrates intelligent optimization, remote interaction, dynamic display of virtual reality and training management. This platform contributes can not only resolve the difficulties of recognition, operation and experimentation for petroleum engineering students in drilling field, but also meet the professional quality training of employees in the rig control field.

articleTitle: Course Model Research of OBE in “Internet Plus” Era
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problems of emphasizing theory and neglecting practice in the courses on financial management, this paper introduces the concept of OBE(Outcome Based Education) into the course of financial management in higher continuing education. This paper collects the data of 8 classes have had financial management course by questionnaire survey, and divides the data into two groups for comparative analysis: the traditional group and the OBE group. Our result shows that: (1) the teaching effect under the OBE is significantly different from that of the traditional teaching method; (2) the effect of OBE on students' classroom behavior and learning effect is greater than that of the traditional teaching method.

articleTitle: Research on Finger Vein Recognition Based on Sub-Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional deep learning finger vein recognition algorithm reduces the recognition rate when there are fewer training samples and training times, a finger vein recognition method based on multi-convolution and multi-scale features is proposed. Two relatively independent sub-convolutional networks with different granularities are used for feature extraction. The convolutional layer uses the LeakyReLU activation function, and the pooling layer uses the maximum value downsampling method. For the object classification of the model, feature extraction from a single layer of different feature extraction as a result, the samples are finally trained through the softmax classifier. Experimental results show that the use of two relatively independent sub-convolutional networks with different granularities can more effectively extract features, and the accuracy rate can reach 95.1% when the sample set is small. At the same time, in the case of picture rotation, the error rate of this method is only 0.0373.

articleTitle: A Tactical Subnet Usability Simulation Strategy Integrating Centrality Index
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: The availability evaluation of tactical communication network can help the army to optimize the network capability and improve the network availability to meet the higher requirements of the business. In this paper, by analyzing it, a strategy for tactical subnet availability is proposed. Using Monte Carlo fault driven method and Markov mathematical modeling method, the availability simulation of tactical communication hierarchical subnet is studied, and a modeling example is given. This strategy has a certain reference value in the availability test and inspection of tactical subnet.

articleTitle: Effect of Fair Value Measurement Model of Investment Property on Company Financial Risks in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: With the economic growth and rising house prices, the investment property measured at historical value obviously cannot reflect the real value and the fair value measurement model becomes more widespread. This article selects the listed companies owning the investment property and using the fair value measurement method from 2014 to 2018 in Chinese A-Share stock market as the research samples. This paper tests the correlation of fair value changes and corporation financial risk. It can be concluded that: (1) Application of fair value measurement model to measure investment property will reduce the financial risk of an enterprise or enterprises. (2) There is a negative correlation between investment property per share measured at fair value and financial risk. (3) The fair value measurement model of investment property has different impact on state-owned enterprises and private enterprises. Based on the above findings, this paper puts forward recommendations for the fair value measurement model of investment property.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Logistics Information Platform Based on Block Chain Technology : Research on urban integration development of Guangdong-Hong kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computer Network, Electronic and Automation (ICCNEA)
abstract: Logistics plays a fundamental and strategic role in the national economy. The Guangdong-Hongkong-Macao Greater Bay Area is the region with the largest flow of goods in the world. The integration of logistics can provide support for the free flow of elements and the integrated development of cities in the greater bay area. Blockchain technology has the technological advantages of decentralization, peer-to-peer transmission, information security and transparency, etc. This technology has multiple coupling with the technical requirements of logistics information resource management in The Guangdong-Hongkong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and can effectively solve many bottlenecks in the current logistics integration development of the greater bay area. According to the technical characteristics of blockchain, this paper designs a blockchain intelligent logistics platform, which can provide reference for the greater bay area to realize the integration of logistics and promote the integration of city clusters.
